interpretation: 64MiB fastest within this one-run capacity-constrained Fabric trial. More repetitions and fixed pool capacity required before recommending a general optimum.
limitations: Archive0 only, four original files, not a single complete eight-file corpus
Fabric workspace was previously right-sized to a low-compute pool for unrelated tiny experiments; actual per-run cores and CU billing were not independently measured
One repetition per setting, fixed-order effects and load/concurrent jobs cannot be excluded
Time is a sum of 12 distinct Spark action groups (four files × three checks), not a complete job including notebook startup, staging, or storage
Not a cross-vendor speed/cost comparison or official UMIG6 conformance
Public Z timestamp labels have unverified UTC semantics
